communications.subject: RE: Order Confirmation - Wrong amount charged
communications.body:
Hello,

I just noticed the charge on my card statement shows $34.99 but the price listed on your website when I purchased was $24.99 plus $5 shipping, which should be $29.99 total. You charged me $5 extra.

Please explain this discrepancy or issue a refund for the difference.

John Smith

communications.subject: RE: Order Confirmation - Wrong amount charged
communications.body:
Hi John,

Thank you for reaching out. I've looked into your order and the $34.99 charge is correct. The USB-C Hub Adapter is priced at $29.99, and the $5.00 is for standard shipping. The price on the website was $29.99 at the time of your purchase — you may be confusing it with a sale price that ended the day before.

I can provide a screenshot of the pricing page from the date of your order if that would help.

Best regards,
Customer Support
TechStore Pro

communications.subject: RE: Order Confirmation - Wrong amount charged
communications.body:
I disagree. The website showed $24.99 when I added it to cart. I took a screenshot and I'm disputing this charge with my bank.

John
